dedupe_keys.name: uk power station transformer dissolved gas analysis data 2010 2015 geomagnetic storm study

description: This data set gives dissolved gas analysis records from the coolant oil of 13 UK power station transformers over various periods between 2010 and 2015. It was published on Zenodo in December 2021 by Zoë M. Lewis, James A. Wild and Matthew Allcock and forms the basis of their paper "Assessing the impact of weak and moderate geomagnetic storms on UK power station transformers" in the AGU journal Space Weather. The data were provided by EDF Energy Nuclear Generation. Each transformer has one CSV file with a header line and timestamped records in Universal Time; concentrations of 8 trace gases are given in parts per million for each phase, except for two transformers with one phase only. Coverage is 13 UK power station transformers identified by letter. The data are a zipped archive of about 4 MB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: transformers and stations are not named, time spans differ, and the storm list must be taken from the paper. Simulation uses are relating geomagnetically induced currents to transformer heating and gas generation and building condition-based fragility for space weather studies. Related records: data-may-2024-storm-gic-observations and model-power-network-model-gic cover geomagnetically induced currents.
